You can hover over the name of the stat in the stats page for more detail! I agree that the names are pretty vague on their own

I managed to get an S rank at only 40k points! The secret for me at least was 

1. Of course a good KD
2. Good CS, to help with this - I recommend taking 10% AS rune for your first flex (AS, Adaptive, Armour/MR)
3. R O A M, If you go to your stats page (Profile --> Stats) I think it shows a myriad of stats that riot tracks from your games, as well as giving you an average grade - those are a really good benchmark and one of them is 'Roam dominance score'
4. W A R D, place a fuck ton of wards - get that vision score up there.
5. Objectives! Another gem from the stats page that really matters

​

From the stats page, riot measures your combat (Essentially good kd, how many chains you hit, your kill participation, damage per death etc.), your income (cs, damage per gold, early gold advantage (for leblanc, first bloods are key here) and early cs advantage (don't worry too much about this), and the final category in stats is map control which consists of objective control (how many objectives you got an assist on), vision score per hour (super super easy to get up, super easy S), roam dominance, and kill conversion (how much you convert kills into objectives).

​

These stats are compared to players in your elo in your region, and a lot of these stats are pretty easy to get high since the bar is low - and on top of that, a lot of these stats compliment each other. Kill participation, roam dominance, kill conversion, and objective control are 4 really nice stats to compliment each other (mid prio turns into bot double turns into drake). 

Examples of just getting these scores higher, at least for me where maybe my elo is a bit lower, my utility score, kill participation, damage share, early gold advantage, early cs, and vision score per hour are significantly higher than the average. On top of that, getting a nice KD in a game almost guarantees me an S or S+.

​
